And dwel with ve : the land is at your commandement, till , occupie,

brethren : Let me find grace in your ſight: and what foeuer you ſhal
appoint I wil giue: 12. raiſe the dowrie, aud require guifts, and I
ſhal gladly giue what vou ſhal demand: ouely giue me this wench to
wife. 13. Iacobs ſounes anſwered Sichem & his father (4) in guile,
being wrath tor the deflouring ot their ſiſter: 14. We can not doe that
which you demand, nor giue out ſiſter to an vncircumnciſed pet ſon :
which with vs is an vnlawful & abhominable thing. 1:. But in this
order we mav be confederate, it you wil be like to vs, and al the man
ſex among vou be circumcifed: 16. then wil we giue and take mutu-
ally your daughters, and ours: and we wil dwel with vou, and wil be
one people : 17. but: if you wil not be circumciſed, we wil take our
daughter, and depart. 18. The offer pleaſed Hemor and Sichem his
ſonne: 19. neither did the vong man make delav, but forthwith ful-
filled that which was demanded : for he loued the wench exceedingly,
and he was the greateſt man in al his tathers houſe. 20. Aud going into
the gate of the citie, they ſpake to the people : 21. Theſe men are men of
ptace, and are willing to dwel with vs : let them occupie in the laud,
and till it, which being large and wide doth lacke men to till it : their
daughters we ſhal take to wife, and outs we wil giue to them. 22. Oue
thing there is tor the which ſo great a good is differred : If we circum-
ciſe our man ſex, following the rite ot the nation.2. And their ſub-
ſtance, and eattle, and al things that they poſſeſſe, ſhal be ours: only in
this let vs condeicend, and dwelling together we ihal make one people.

when they had boldly atcheiued. Iacob ſaid to Simeon and Leui : You
haue ttoubled me, and mnade te odious to the Chananites, and Phere-

gether wil ſtrike me : and I and my houſe ſnal be deſtroyed. 31. They
